concepts.name: Vocation
concepts.definition: Central learning focus developed by the chapter 'Vocation'.
concepts.evidence: Let us Recite (1) When the gong sounds ten in the morning and I walk to school by our lane, Every day I meet the hawker crying, “Bangles, crystal bangles!” There is nothing to hurry him on, there is no road he must take, no place he must go to, no time when he must come home.
